verdict.rationale: Ubuntu's own materials advertise "Thousands of applications" backed by "the full Ubuntu archive for packages and updates," and its documentation includes an "Install an application" guide, which together cover installing many apps from an official source. Community comments do not address the catalog's functionality. Missing for 10: an explicit description of the official catalog front-end or store and how it works, documented catalog size beyond the marketing phrase, and independent or hands-on corroboration of installing from it.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can install thousands of applications directly from an official software catalog
